tagline: The market infrastructure for living inventory
growVerifyTrade: Grow it. Verify it. Supply it. Trade it. Reuse it.

personaBodies.guest: Market, news, and the catalog are open. Greenhouse and rank ask you to sign in.
personaBodies.new: A blank account. No plants, nothing listed.
personaBodies.unverified: Owns plants, but publishRequirement is verified — listing stays blocked.
personaBodies.richCollection: A full shelf with passports, cuttings, and pending market listings.
personaBodies.richCollector: A collector greenhouse with statement plants and grades.
personaBodies.richNursery: Nursery stock with trays, listings, and volume.
personaBodies.admin: Same rich world, plus catalog and system configuration.

login.title: Sign in to PlantX
login.subtitle: Continue with a demo greenhouse, or browse as a guest

discover.sub: Keep the plants you grow, then bring them to the market.
discover.lureTitle: A quiet shelf for what you grow
discover.lureBody: One photo and a name is enough to begin. When a plant is ready, the market is a step away.
discover.lureYoursBody: Open the greenhouse to add another, or list one when you want to sell.

market.title: Market
market.searchPlaceholder: Search a plant, a variety, or a code
market.catalogFilterHint: Category and subcategory come from the same catalog as admin.
market.requiredFilterHint: Health, size, and stage match the required catalog fields.
market.catalogTraitsHint: Traits grey out when they do not apply to your category selection.
market.intentRecorded: Purchase intent recorded (POC — no real payment)

exchange.title: PlantX Market
exchange.subtitle: Stock market for living inventory — prices by standardized plant class
exchange.chartNote: Mock history derived from completed-sale comps for the POC — not a promise of future prices.

grade.title: Rank
grade.guestBody: Community grades are anonymous and need an account. The market stays open to browse.
grade.description: Plants published from greenhouses, one card at a time. Your grade is anonymous and feeds the community grade on each passport.
grade.hint: Swipe up for S, right for A, down for B, left for C. Arrow keys work too.
grade.emptyHint: New plants published from greenhouses will show up here.
grade.noActivity: No one has graded this plant yet.

passport.title: Plant passport
passport.notListed: This plant is not listed yet.
passport.verifyReason: This listing photo is more than a week old.
passport.sellReason: You own it, and it is not listed.
passport.marketEmpty: No live listings for this class yet

greenhouse.title: Greenhouse
greenhouse.guestTitle: Sign in to open your greenhouse
greenhouse.guestBody: Guests can browse the market and the catalog. Plants, listing, and the wallet stay on an account.
greenhouse.description: Your shelf of plants — passports, care, and what grows next.
greenhouse.levelEarnPlant: +{xp} XP for every plant you add
greenhouse.levelEarnCare: +{xp} XP for every care task you complete
greenhouse.empty: No plants yet — add one with a photo and a description
greenhouse.addPhotoHint: Choose an image from this device
greenhouse.addClassNote: Category, subcategory, and required properties come from the shared catalog. Extra traits sit in More properties.
greenhouse.visitorNote: You can build a greenhouse without an account. Selling asks you to log in or register.
greenhouse.formCatalogHint: Pick the category and subcategory from the shared catalog.
greenhouse.formRequiredHint: Health, size, and stage are always required.
greenhouse.formOptionalHint: Optional traits for this category or subcategory.
greenhouse.identifyNotPlant: That photo does not look like a plant
greenhouse.promptAdd: Add the first plant to this collection
greenhouse.promptVerify: Refresh a market photo once a week
greenhouse.addCardHint: Snap a photo · AI fills in the rest
greenhouse.emptyTitle: Your greenhouse is ready for its first plant
greenhouse.emptyBody: Take a photo and AI identifies the plant, maps it to the catalog, and fills in the details. You check and save.

todo.title: Tasks
todo.description: Water and photo tasks for your plants, on a calendar.
todo.detailFirstWater: Pick the day you last watered — today or earlier. The next watering follows a week later.
todo.fillWindowWater: Only today and the past week. The next watering is a week after the day you pick.
todo.fillWindowPhoto: Only today and the past month. The next photo is a month after the day you pick.
todo.fillNotDue: Due {day}. You can fill it on that day, not before.
todo.emptyDay: Pick one or more days to see their tasks.
todo.guestBody: Watering and photo reminders stay on your account.

addPlant.title: Add a plant
addPlant.lead: Snap a photo. AI reads the plant and fills in the catalog for you; you stay in control of every field.
addPlant.photoLead: Add a clear photo first. Then analyze it with AI, or leave that off and fill the form yourself.
addPlant.photoLeadOne: Add a clear photo first. Then analyze it with AI, or leave that off and fill the form yourself.
addPlant.dropTitle: Drop up to {max} photos or tap to choose
addPlant.dropTitleOne: Drop a photo or tap to choose
addPlant.dropHint: Up to {max} photos, JPG or PNG.
addPlant.scanStage1: Looking at leaf shape, veins, and color
addPlant.scanStage3: Matching the answer to the PlantX catalog
addPlant.demoNote: Demo answer: no API was called and no credits were used.
addPlant.notInCatalogTitle: AI recognized it, but it's not in the catalog
addPlant.notInCatalogBody: {label} isn't a PlantX category yet. Other is selected for the category and the subcategory.
addPlant.notPlantTitle: That doesn't look like a plant
addPlant.notPlantBody: Try another photo, or fill in the details by hand. Plants filled in by hand are marked “Not verified by AI”.
addPlant.failedBody: None of the identify providers answered. Fill in the details yourself; this plant will be marked “Not verified by AI”.
addPlant.noAccessBody: Sign in to have AI identify your plant. You can still fill it in by hand; it will be marked “Not verified by AI”.
addPlant.identityLeadAi: AI picked these from the catalog. Tap another to change.
addPlant.identityLeadManual: Pick the category and variety from the shared catalog.
addPlant.bannerAi: Filled in by AI. Keep it to save the plant as AI verified.
addPlant.bannerAiOther: AI recognized {label}. It is not in the catalog yet, so it is saved as Other and still AI verified.
addPlant.bannerEdited: You changed AI's answer. The plant will be saved as edited by you, not AI verified.
addPlant.bannerManual: Not verified by AI. You're choosing the class yourself.
addPlant.specsLead: Size and stage set the market class of this plant.
addPlant.detailsLead: A short note. The place comes from your greenhouse settings.
addPlant.descriptionPlaceholder: New leaves, variegation, pot, anything a buyer should know
addPlant.reviewLead: Check everything once more. Tap Edit to change a field.
addPlant.manualHint: Saved as not verified by AI
addPlant.photoReadyBody: Continue with AI, or fill the form yourself.
addPlant.skipPhotoHint: No photo? You can still fill it in by hand
addPlant.needSpecs: Pick size, stage, and the required traits
addPlant.morePhotosHint: Add another angle. Each photo gets its own AI check.
addPlant.maxPhotosHint: {max} photos is the limit. Remove one to swap it.

sell.title: Sell / Propagate
sell.publishedNote: This plant is pending until the market opens. You can see it in your greenhouse.
sell.intro: Every listing becomes a tradable market class with its own verified plant identity underneath.
sell.typePlantHint: One established plant with its own passport
sell.typeCuttingHint: Rooted or unrooted cuttings sold per unit
sell.typeBundleHint: A grouped batch sold together at one price
sell.photoHint: PNG or JPG — mocked in this POC, click to attach a sample
sell.needsVerified: Publishing needs a verified plant. Verify it from its passport first.
sell.needsGraded: Publishing needs at least one community grade. Wait for the community to grade it.

profile.title: Profile
profile.addressNote: exact address shared only after purchase
profile.bio: Growing and trading verified living inventory on PlantX.
profile.reviewQuote: Healthy plants and easy pickup. Great communication.
profile.collectionBody: Track every plant you grow, its passport, and where it is in the marketplace.
profile.trustTipBody: Plants with open passports sell 2× faster. Add care logs to your listings.
profile.guestBody: The market is open. Your greenhouse stays on this device. Purchase history and private details need an account.
profile.unknownHint: This appears after finished trades. The other person grades the handoff: stars, fulfillment, and cancellations.
profile.nicknameHint: This is the name on your greenhouse.
profile.iconHint: Starts as a seed. More icons unlock as your greenhouse levels up.

auth.sellBody: Your greenhouse is already saved on this device. Publishing a listing needs an account.
auth.historyBody: Orders and purchase history are visible only on a registered account.
auth.sensitiveBody: Address, verification, and ratings stay on a registered account.
auth.rankBody: You can look through the stack freely. Grades are saved, anonymously, once you log in or pick a demo scenario.
auth.tagline: The shelf evolved. Finally, living inventory has too.
auth.switchToLogin: Already have an account? Log in
auth.pendingBody: Your account is being reviewed. We'll let you in as soon as it's approved.
auth.offline: Could not reach the server. Try again in a moment.
auth.loginBody: Use your Google account to sign in.
auth.registerBody: Create your PlantX account with Google. It takes a few seconds.
auth.pendingHint: Once approved, sign in again with the same Google account. You can browse as a guest meanwhile.
auth.declined: This account can't sign in right now.
auth.googleUnavailable: Google sign-in isn't available right now. Try again later.

seller.greenhouseEmpty: Nothing shared from this greenhouse yet

admin.title: Admin
admin.operatorOnly: Admin opens only with your Google account.
admin.issuesLead: What people sent when something failed. Their note is here. The request, stack, and browser details are in the row.
admin.configurationsLead: One catalog for admin, market filters, and new plants. Add categories and subcategories with their own properties.
admin.systemLead: Control which pages are shown and which features are available.
admin.serverLead: Backoffice tables for live data — preview rows, bulk actions, reports, members, and transactions.
admin.requestsLead: Pending applications and plants the catalog does not know yet. History keeps what was added and what was declined.
admin.apisLead: Photo identify — plant check, species, and catalog fields.
admin.apisChainLead: Add Plant runs three stages. Each one can be Ready (real API) or Mock (no credits). A plant check that says it is not a plant stops before Pl@ntNet.
admin.apisModeMockHint: Canned provider responses. No credits spent.
admin.apisPlaygroundLead: A pipeline run sets Ready or Mock on each stage. A single stage uses the mode below.
admin.apisResultEmpty: Run a test to see the result.
admin.apisStageGateLead: Gemini looks at the photo and only decides if it is a plant.
admin.apisStageSpeciesLead: Pl@ntNet names the species. It runs only after the plant check says yes.
admin.apisStageDraftLead: Gemini fills PlantX fields from the species result and the catalog as it is now.
admin.apisHistoryLead: Every identify request, from Add Plant and from this playground.
admin.serverUpBody: Reading users, plants, and activities from the database API.
admin.serverDownBody: Writes stay blocked until the API answers.
admin.serverSliceUnavailable: This list could not be loaded.
admin.serverFailTimeout: The API did not answer in time.
admin.serverFailHtml: HTTP {status} — the host returned a page instead of the API.
admin.serverFailHttp: HTTP {status}{error} — the API refused the request.
admin.serverFailDown: HTTP {status} — nothing is answering the API. The server process is down, or the host could not reach it.
admin.systemAppLead: Off sends visitors to the not-launched page. You still see the app while signed in.
admin.systemPagesLead: Stop showing a page to put it under maintenance. Direct visits see a maintenance notice.
admin.systemFeaturesLead: Each group is a feature. Hideable components sit open under their page. Always shown and non controllable pieces stay folded.
admin.catalogLead: Categories, subcategories, and properties are the same source the market and add-plant form use.
admin.suggestedCategoriesLead: Identify found these plants and they are not in the catalog yet.
admin.suggestedFormLead: Filled from the identify answer and the scan photo. Edit, then save the category, subcategory, and properties together.
admin.suggestedPropertyInvalid: Each property needs a name and at least one option with a sign. Market signs must be unique.
admin.suggestedSaveFailed: Could not save. The ticker or a property sign is already used.
admin.categoryChipHint: Edit a row to change names, ticker, and photo. Select a category to add and edit its properties.
admin.subcategoryChipHint: Choose a working category, then select a subcategory to add and edit its properties.
admin.propertyChipHint: Properties apply to the selected category or subcategory scope.
admin.optionsHint: Each option replaces the property placeholder. Signs show in parentheses.
admin.requiredPropertiesHint: Add or edit labels and options. These apply to every plant in the catalog.
admin.noCategoryProperties: No properties on this category yet.
admin.noSubProperties: No properties on this subcategory yet.
admin.editCatalogHint: Choose what you are editing. Subcategories and properties apply to this selection.
admin.noSubcategories: No subcategories in this category yet.
admin.marketNamesLead: Every name from a category, its subcategories, and the properties that apply.

charts.categoryLadderHint: Bar = lowest to highest range · dots = classes by health

guide.subtitle: Care, seasons, and health for every plant class.

landing.heroTitle: Your greenhouse, alive on every screen.
landing.heroSub: Snap a plant and AI fills in its passport. Each new plant and each finished care task earns XP, and your greenhouse level climbs.
landing.proof1Body: One photo in, a catalog class out
landing.proof3Body: 50 XP for a new plant, 10 XP for each finished care task
landing.tourLead: These are real PlantX screens. Pick an area, and switch between desktop and phone where both exist.
landing.tourHomeTitle: A feed of greenhouses that grow.
landing.tourHomeBody: Every water, photo, new cutting and grade from the growers around you, as it happens.
landing.tourGreenhouseTitle: A level that grows with the shelf.
landing.tourGreenhouseBody: The level ring, your rank, and the XP to the next level lead the page. Under that is every plant you own.
landing.tourGreenhouse1: 50 XP for each plant you add
landing.tourGreenhouse2: 10 XP for each care task you finish
landing.tourGreenhouse3: Add a plant from a single photo
landing.tourPassportBody: Photos, catalog identity, health, size, stage and owner, with the full care history behind it.
landing.tourPassport1: AI verified badge when the answer is kept
landing.tourPassport2: Planned care and history per plant
landing.tourPassport3: Up to three photos, each checked
landing.tourTasksTitle: Care that shows up on time.
landing.tourTasksBody: A calendar of watering and photo check-ins for each plant. Tick one off, it lands on the passport, and the greenhouse earns 10 XP.
landing.tourTasks1: Filter by plant or by care type
landing.tourTasks3: Task count right in the nav
landing.tourCatalogBody: Care guides per species and variety, with light and water for this season.
landing.tourCatalog2: The same classes AI matches to
landing.aiTitle: From one photo to a full plant passport.
landing.aiLead: Add a plant with a single photo. AI checks it is a plant, names the species and matches it to the PlantX catalog. You confirm or change any field.
landing.ai1Body: One clear photo is all Add Plant needs to start.
landing.ai2Body: It checks the photo is really a plant, then compares leaf shape, veins and color with known species.
landing.ai3Body: Category, variety, size and stage are picked from the shared catalog. Tap any chip to change it.
landing.ai4Body: Keep the answer and the plant carries an AI verified badge on its passport.
landing.joinBody: Sign up with your Google account. Already growing here? Log in with the same button.
